two planar equal-radius components on one sphere

choices: Two parallel xy circles of radius 0.4 at z=-0.3 and z=+0.3, hence every member remains at radius 0.5 about the origin. Each ring has an alternating 3:3 word, three opposite-polarity antipodal pairs, and angular-rate magnitude pi/2. The upper ring starts pi/3 ahead.
Both rings circulate positively about z.
This is a chosen geometry and motion representative; no shared-sphere balance is claimed.

History spans two source periods with 64 cubic intervals per period. Delay horizon zero denotes display-only coverage, not a supplied causal ledger. The common center is fixed; c_f=1. The schema braid role marks primary assembly members, not an assigned braid identity. Only explicit componentBraids assign composition.
